article.linkText: Pelicans beat Clippers 105-104 in NBA Cup group finale
article.story: INGLEWOOD, Calif. -- — Zion Williamson and Trey Murphy III each scored 25 points and the New Orleans Pelicans beat the Los Angeles Clippers 105-104 on Friday night in their NBA Cup group finale. Both teams were 1/3 in group play. Williamson was 11 of 15 from the field and had seven rebounds and five assists. Murphy was 9 of 16 and had six steals. Darius Garland led Los Angeles with 19 points. Brook Lopez had 17, hitting a 3-pointer in the final second to make it a one-point game. The Pelicans snapped a four-game losing streak to improve to 6-14. The Clippers have lost six in a row to fall to 4-14. Up next Pelicans: At Portland on Sunday. Clippers: At Golden State on Sunday. ------ See AP’s full NBA coverage here
